F13-1 MSC-1 20 kV single-line diagram for one transformer section with the test points of chapter 13

150/20 kV 80 MVA transformer, uk 16.5 % · 20 kV bus section A, 31.5 kA class, 13.2 kA with the tie open · incomer CT 3000/1 A · feeder CT 1500/1 A · 12/20 (24) kV XLPE feeder cable to the building B2 20 kV board, which supplies the 2.5 MVA

• The bus section fault level with the tie open is 13.2 kA and with the tie closed 25.0 kA; both are below the 31.5 kA switchgear rating, so the test record states which configuration the protection settings assume.
• Every cable between the switchboard and the block transformer receives the T7 sheath test, the T8 VLF withstand and tan delta test and a T9 phasing check before it is energised.
